note: Public NHANES 2011-2014 ActiGraph GT3X+ raw 80 Hz acceleration in g, non-dominant wrist. No activity annotations: every session carries __unlabeled__ and is barred from label vocabulary, validation probes, and the Phase-B bank. Fetching is bounded and deterministic; full-corpus download (~2.2 TB compressed) is intentionally unavailable. Hour budget is spent motion-aware by default (see convert.select_hours) because free-living wrist data is mostly stillness. Grids are float16.
